title: 前面有落
mood: a comic standoff that turns into a singalong
subject: a passenger who calls her minibus stop two traffic lights too late, and all sixteen passengers taking sides
caption: Cantonese original musical theatre, a comic ensemble number from a book musical. A theatre pit orchestra: a driving piano conductor part, pizzicato strings turning to bowed strings, a clarinet and bassoon answering the singers, bright brass punctuation on the jokes, timpani and a snare roll on every stop. The orchestra stops and restarts with the action, slowing for a short solo section and then returning faster. Roomy and stage-like, voices dry and forward, orchestra spread wide behind. A female character voice moving from spoken lines into a full belt, a gruff male driver character answering her, and a full ensemble chorus as the other passengers, clear diction with every word on a note. 112 BPM, Bb major. A comic standoff that turns into a singalong. No pop drum kit, no synths, no autotune, no rock guitar, no rap.
lyrics:
[Verse]
司機！ 前面有落呀！
吓？ 過咗？ 過咗兩個燈位？
我頭先睇緊手機 冇抬過頭
求吓你 喺度停一停

[Verse]
呢度雙黃線 停唔得
你自己唔叫 唔好怪我

[Chorus]
前面有落！ 前面有落！
十六個人 十六個意見
後面阿伯話「停啦」 前面靚仔話「唔好停」
成架van 為咗一個站 嘈到拆天

[Verse]
隔籬個師奶話「後生女趕時間 停吓啦」
著住校服個細路話「停咗我咪遲到囉」
有人話報警 有人話打去運輸署
司機一拍軚盤「再嘈 我兜返去總站！」

[Bridge]
我今日見工 已經遲咗十分鐘
我淨係想 行少兩步

[Chorus]
前面有落！ 前面有落！
十六個人 一齊幫佢叫「停啦」
司機嘆咗啖氣 打燈 埋邊
「下次早啲講！」 「多謝晒！」

[Verse]
佢揸住份履歷 跑返兩個燈位
司機開返車 收音機播緊首老歌
後面阿伯跟住哼 越哼越大聲

[Chorus]
前面有落！ 前面有落！
成車人 跟住阿伯一齊唱
阿伯唱得太開心 連自己個站都過埋
成架van 一齊嗌「司機！ 前面有落！」

[Outro]
下個站 仲有冇人落？
有！
